2:   @moduledoc """
3:   Oban worker that sends transactional emails through the Swoosh transport
4:   seam (ADR 0021 — Swoosh Is the Email Transport Seam).
5: 
6:   Migrated from the `process-emails` Deno edge function. Each job represents
7:   a single email (one Oban job per message, replacing the pgmq batch-read
8:   pattern).
9: 
10:   ## Job args (public contract — unchanged)
11: 
12:     * `email` — the recipient email address
13:     * `transactional_id` — the Email Kind (`"inviteMember"`,
14:       `"workshopAnnouncement"`, `"workshopRegistration"`,
15:       `"workshopRegistrationError"`, `"magicLink"`). The worker derives the
16:       Resend template alias mechanically in kebab-case.
17:     * `data_variables` — key-value pairs injected into the email template
18:       (values must be strings or numbers)
19: 
20:   ## Delivery
21: 
22:   The worker builds one `%Swoosh.Email{}` per job — recipient, sender, and
23:   Resend template option — and hands it to `Dhc.Email.Mailer`. The configured
24:   adapters are `Swoosh.Adapters.Resend` in prod, `Swoosh.Adapters.Mailpit`
25:   over HTTP in dev (`http://localhost:8025` web UI), and
26:   `Swoosh.Adapters.Test` in tests.
27: 
28:   Outside prod the message is decorated with a JSON summary body
29:   (recipient + friendly Kind + data variables) so the dev inbox shows who
30:   would receive what; providers render real bodies from their templates.
31: 
32:   ## Idempotency
33: 
34:   Every send carries an `Idempotency-Key` derived from the Oban job id
35:   (`oban-<job.id>`), applied at the HTTP layer by `Dhc.Email.ApiClient`.
36:   Provider retries therefore cannot double-send a delivered email.
37: 
38:   ## Error classification
39: 
40:     * Invalid job args are deterministic: the job is **cancelled
41:       immediately** (`{:cancel, _}`) with a Sentry capture instead of burning
42:       five identical attempts.
43:     * In prod, provider responses of 4xx (except 429 rate limiting) are
44:       deterministic rejections too: cancelled with Sentry capture. Rate
45:       limits, 5xx, and network errors are transient: returned as
46:       `{:error, reason}` for Oban's exponential-backoff retries
47:       (`max_attempts: 5`).
48:     * Outside prod, delivery failures are logged and swallowed (`:ok`) —
49:       a stopped Mailpit container must never fail or retry dev jobs.
50: 
51:   ## Logging
52: 
53:   Every log line carries the Oban job context (`oban_job_id`, `oban_attempt`,
54:   `oban_queue`, `oban_worker`) plus `email` and `transactional_id`, so
55:   failures can be correlated to a specific job.
56:   """
57: 
58:   use Oban.Worker, queue: :emails, max_attempts: 5
59: 
60:   require Logger
61: 
62:   alias Dhc.Email.Mailer
63:   alias Swoosh.Email
64: 
65:   @transactional_ids ~w(inviteMember workshopAnnouncement workshopRegistration workshopRegistrationError magicLink)
66:   @idempotency_header "Idempotency-Key"
67: 
68:   @impl Worker
69:   def perform(%Oban.Job{args: args} = job) do
70:     ctx = job_log_context(job)
71: 
72:     with :ok <- validate_args(args, ctx),
73:          :ok <- deliver(args, job, ctx) do
74:       :ok
75:     else
76:       {:cancel, _reason} = cancelled -> cancelled
77:       {:error, _reason} = retryable -> retryable
78:     end
79:   end
80: 
81:   # -- Argument validation ----------------------------------------------------
82: 
83:   defp validate_args(args, ctx) do
84:     errors =
85:       []
86:       |> validate_required(args, "email")
87:       |> validate_email_format(args)
88:       |> validate_required(args, "transactional_id")
89:       |> validate_transactional_id(args)
90:       |> validate_data_variables(args)
91: 
92:     case errors do
93:       [] ->
94:         :ok
95: 
96:       errors ->
97:         message = "Invalid email job args: #{Enum.join(errors, ", ")}"
98: 
99:         Logger.error(
100:           "[email-worker] #{message}",
101:           Keyword.merge(ctx,
102:             email: args["email"],
103:             transactional_id: args["transactional_id"],
104:             validation_errors: Enum.join(errors, ", ")
105:           )
106:         )
107: 
108:         capture_deterministic_failure(message, ctx,
109:           args: args,
110:           validation_errors: errors
111:         )
112: 
113:         {:cancel, {:validation, errors}}
114:     end
115:   end
116: 
117:   defp validate_required(errors, args, field) do
118:     if is_nil(args[field]) or args[field] == "" do
119:       ["missing #{field}" | errors]
120:     else
121:       errors
122:     end
123:   end
124: 
125:   defp validate_email_format(errors, %{"email" => email}) when is_binary(email) do
126:     if email =~ ~r/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ do
127:       errors
128:     else
129:       ["invalid email format" | errors]
130:     end
131:   end
132: 
133:   defp validate_email_format(errors, _args), do: errors
134: 
135:   defp validate_transactional_id(errors, %{"transactional_id" => id})
136:        when id in @transactional_ids,
137:        do: errors
138: 
139:   defp validate_transactional_id(errors, _args),
140:     do: ["invalid transactional_id" | errors]
141: 
142:   defp validate_data_variables(errors, %{"data_variables" => vars}) when is_map(vars) do
143:     invalid_values =
144:       Enum.any?(vars, fn
145:         {_k, v} when is_binary(v) -> false
146:         {_k, v} when is_number(v) -> false
147:         _ -> true
148:       end)
149: 
150:     if invalid_values do
151:       ["data_variables values must be strings or numbers" | errors]
152:     else
153:       errors
154:     end
155:   end
156: 
157:   defp validate_data_variables(errors, _args), do: errors
158: 
159:   # -- Delivery ----------------------------------------------------------------
160: 
161:   defp deliver(
162:          %{"email" => recipient, "transactional_id" => kind} = args,
163:          %Oban.Job{} = job,
164:          ctx
165:        ) do
166:     data_variables = Map.get(args, "data_variables", %{})
167: 
168:     recipient
169:     |> build_email(kind, data_variables, job.id)
170:     |> deliver_email(kind, ctx)
171:   end
172: 
173:   defp build_email(recipient, kind, data_variables, oban_job_id) do
174:     email =
175:       Email.new()
176:       |> Email.from(email_from())
177:       |> Email.to(recipient)
178:       |> Email.put_provider_option(:template, %{
179:         id: template_alias(kind),
180:         variables: data_variables
181:       })
182: 
183:     if oban_job_id do
184:       key = "oban-#{oban_job_id}"
185: 
186:       email
187:       |> Email.put_provider_option(:idempotency_key, key)
188:       # MIME-level copy for dev-inbox observability; the wire header comes from
189:       # the provider option via Dhc.Email.ApiClient.
190:       |> Email.header(@idempotency_header, key)
191:     else
192:       email
193:     end
194:     |> decorate_for_dev(recipient, kind, data_variables)
195:   end
196: 
197:   # Non-prod only: providers render real bodies from their templates, so the
198:   # dev inbox gets a JSON summary (recipient + friendly Kind + variables).
199:   defp decorate_for_dev(email, recipient, kind, data_variables) do
200:     if env() == :prod do
201:       email
202:     else
203:       payload = %{
204:         email: recipient,
205:         transactional_id: kind,
206:         data_variables: data_variables
207:       }
208: 
209:       subject = "[dev] Email: #{kind}"
210:       body = Jason.encode!(payload, pretty: true)
211: 
212:       email
213:       |> Email.subject(subject)
214:       |> Email.text_body(body)
215:     end
216:   end
217: 
218:   defp deliver_email(%Email{} = email, kind, ctx) do
219:     case Mailer.deliver(email) do
220:       {:ok, receipt} ->
221:         Logger.info(
222:           "[email-worker] Email sent successfully",
223:           Keyword.merge(ctx,
224:             email: recipient_address(email),
225:             transactional_id: kind,
226:             receipt: inspect(receipt)
227:           )
228:         )
229: 
230:         :ok
231: 
232:       {:error, reason} ->
233:         handle_delivery_error(reason, kind, ctx)
234:     end
235:   end
236: 
237:   defp handle_delivery_error(reason, kind, ctx) do
238:     if env() == :prod do
239:       classify_delivery_error(reason, kind, ctx)
240:     else
241:       Logger.warning(
242:         "[email-worker] Dev relay delivery failed (is `docker compose up -d mailpit` running?), job will not retry",
243:         Keyword.merge(ctx,
244:           transactional_id: kind,
245:           reason: inspect(reason)
246:         )
247:       )
248: 
249:       :ok
250:     end
251:   end
252: 
253:   # Deterministic rejections (4xx except rate limiting): retrying cannot fix a
254:   # bad payload or template mapping, so cancel immediately with a Sentry
255:   # capture rather than burn all attempts.
256:   defp classify_delivery_error({status, _body}, kind, ctx)
257:        when is_integer(status) and status >= 400 and status < 500 and status != 429 do
258:     message = "Provider rejected #{kind}; discarding job"
259: 
260:     Logger.error(
261:       "[email-worker] #{message}",
262:       Keyword.merge(ctx,
263:         transactional_id: kind,
264:         provider_status: status
265:       )
266:     )
267: 
268:     capture_deterministic_failure(message, ctx,
269:       transactional_id: kind,
270:       provider_status: status
271:     )
272: 
273:     {:cancel, {:provider_rejected, status}}
274:   end
275: 
276:   # Rate limits (429), 5xx, and network errors are transient — let Oban retry
277:   # with backoff. The Idempotency-Key makes those retries safe against
278:   # double-sends that were already accepted.
279:   defp classify_delivery_error(reason, kind, ctx) do
280:     Logger.error(
281:       "[email-worker] Transient delivery failure; Oban will retry",
282:       Keyword.merge(ctx,
283:         transactional_id: kind,
284:         reason: inspect(reason)
285:       )
286:     )

288:     {:error, reason}

295:   end

297:   defp template_alias(kind) do

316:     )
